fields.label: Include Related Categories
fields.name: include_related_categories
fields.instructions: Select categories which will be included for Similar Projects. Only one method will be used in the order 1) Custom Similar Projects 2) Include Related Categories 3) Exclude Related Categories. If none of these are selected then the Project Categories will be used to find Similar Projects.

fields.label: Exclude Related Categories
fields.name: exclude_related_categories
fields.instructions: Choose categories to be excluded from Similar Projects categories. This will only be used if Custom Similar Projects and Include Related Categories aren't used.
